answer: Re-attestations are stored in inlet and mirror lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the relic graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1333 impostors cost 1054 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
